info.title: VIGO Rust standalone API
info.description: Prepared City routing and isochrones. Public result schemas are shared with the Node CLI; raw native and trace contracts are separate. Runtime validates mode combinations and native index/array invariants beyond these structural schemas. Bearer auth is optional only when no token is configured on a loopback listener.
